paragraphs.source_en: Mario Escamilla had had it with Porky. Escamilla had been stuck in the Arctic with Donald Leavitt (aka “Porky”) for over a month, and Porky was being a total dick. In particular, Porky was the kind of dick who would steal people’s alcohol while wielding a butcher’s cleaver. On July 16, 1970, Escamilla’s roommate called him to say that a drunken Porky had stolen their wine. Escamilla grabbed a rifle and confronted Porky, whom he found drinking a cocktail of ethyl alcohol, grape juice, and raisin wine with the station manager (a man named Bennie Lightsey). Lightsey and Escamilla ended up having a heated conversation as to Porky’s behavior vis-à-vis the raisin wine of other Arctic base residents, during which Escamilla began waving a rifle around. At some point in the process, the rifle went off, inadvertently killing Lightsey.
